name: First Note
hint: Tap a tile to hear its note and select it. Press ▶ Play: the ring starts there and follows the arrows, one tile per beat. Your chain must play the tune shown above.

name: Gaps
hint: Rings leap over empty slots to the next tile in line. Tap tiles to hear them before you Play.

name: Dial
hint: Gold dials only turn: tap one to rotate it clockwise (right-click or hold to turn back). Dials always start pointing the wrong way and can never start the chain: set them, then select a plain tile and press ▶ Play.

name: Split
hint: A split tile always rings out of both its sides, whichever side the ring came in from. Several starts ring every tile, but only one plays the tune.

name: Branches
hint: Many starts ring every tile, and several begin like the tune. Listen to the whole strip: only one plays it.

name: Hush
hint: Striped tiles stay silent unless two rings hit them on the same beat; then they join the chord.

name: Delay
hint: Hourglass tiles hold the ring one extra beat before passing it on.

name: Chorus
hint: Splits, silence, delay and a dial: count the beats.

name: Tuning
hint: Three dials. Every setting rings, only one sings.
